findings.message: Manual allocation/deallocation needs ownership and exception-safety review
findings.recommendation: Assess RAII and ownership; preserve ABI and destruction order

refactor_plan.cause: Manual allocation/deallocation needs ownership and exception-safety review
refactor_plan.contract: UNVERIFIED: establish ownership, observable behavior, public API/ABI and failure guarantees at a.cpp:1
refactor_plan.minimal: Verify the candidate and change only the affected expression or owner. Assess RAII and ownership; preserve ABI and destruction order
refactor_plan.structural: Consider a boundary or ownership change only if call/dependency and consumer evidence establishes a benefit.
refactor_plan.leave_as_is: Keep the implementation if the suspected defect is disproved or migration costs outweigh evidenced benefit; record the reason.
refactor_plan.verification: Reproduce the issue; run affected target, regression and consumer tests; add sanitizer/ABI checks when the contract requires them.
refactor_plan.risks: Unverified contracts, semantic drift, error/cleanup changes, ABI incompatibility and performance regressions require review.
